name: hash so that near points collide with high probability
mechanism: choose random hash functions under which two points collide with probability increasing in their similarity, bucket points by several such hashes, and answer a near-neighbour query by checking only the query's buckets

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Locality-sensitive hashing (LSH)' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: a method of performing probabilistic dimension reduction of high-dimensional data

requires: a similarity with a matching hash family (a human prior)
fails_when: false negatives; many tables for high recall
